name: Xi Zhang
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022-2026); Forbes annual (2021); Hurun Global (2021-2023); Hurun China (2016-2026)
forbes_bio: Zhang Xi chairs Shandong Sinocera Functional Material, a supplier of ceramic materials.
Zhang Xi holds an undergraduate degree from China University of Petroleum and a master's degree in computing from the University of Houston.
He founded Sinocera in Shandong Province in 2005.

name: Forrest Preston
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2015-2025); Hurun Global (2015-2026)
forbes_bio: Forrest Preston founded Life Care Centers of America in 1970 and has since made a fortune with facilities that house and care for the elderly.
The private firm operates over 200 nursing homes, assisted living facilities and retirement living communities in 27 states.
Preston is the CEO and sole owner of the company, which is based in Cleveland, Tennessee.
In 2016, the company agreed to pay $145 million to settle a government lawsuit alleging that the firm had over-billed federal healthcare programs.
In February 2020, an LCCA facility in Seattle became the epicenter of Washington's Covid-19 outbreak as nursing homes across the country struggled.
forbes_facts: Before founding the company, Preston sold vacuum cleaners, worked as an X-ray technician and ran a printing business with his brother.
His first facility, formerly called Garden Terrace Convalescent Center, is still open today in Cleveland, Tennessee.

name: Cheng Zhenghui
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026); Hurun China (2021-2026)
forbes_bio: Cheng Zhenghui is the founder of APT Medical, a supplier of medical devices.
APT is headquartered in the southern Chinese business hub Shenzhen.
APT went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2021.
Cheng stepped down as chairman in April 2025.

name: Shrikant Badve
forbes_bio: Shrikant Badve is the founder and managing director of Pune-based automotive parts supplier Belrise Industries, which makes everything from shock absorbers to rearview mirrors for motorcycles, cars and commercial vehicles.
The company's marquee clients include motorbike manufacturers Eicher, Hero Motocorp and TVS, as well as auto companies Jaguar Land Rover and Mahindra and Mahindra.
Badve started out making fasteners in 1988 in a 150-square-foot shed with three machines and two workers.
Belrise shares were listed in May 2025 at an 11% premium to the issue price.
His wife Supriya sits on the board and his sons, Sumedh (a Harvard MBA) and Swastid (a Wharton graduate), lead business development and strategy respectively.

name: Liu Feng
appears_on: Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun China (2019-2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2025-2026)

name: Samuel Chen
forbes_bio: Samuel Chen was an early investor in Zoom and served as its director until 2018. He made the investment after playing football with founder Eric Yuan in San Francisco.
He also invested in a range of biotech and electronics companies in Taiwan through his Digital Mobile Venture and sits on the board of many.
His majority-owned cancer drug research firm Polaris Group went public in Taiwan in 2022.
Chen earned his initial wealth by trading ink.

name: Lei Jufang
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2010-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2008-2026); Hurun Self-Made Women (2017-2020)
forbes_bio: Lei Jufang chairs Tibet Cheezheng Tibetan Medicine,  best known for its pain-relief patches and cream.
Lei discovered the business that made her a billionaire on a leisure trip to Tibet seeking peace of mind.
Lei holds an undergraduate degree from Xian Jiaotong University in vacuum physics.

name: Victor Linnik
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Victor Linnik co-founded Miratorg, the leading Russian pork and beef producer, with his brother Alexander, in 1995.
Miratorg is the largest owner of agricultural lands in Russia. Company controls about 1.4 million hectares, equivalent to 3.4 million acres.
Miratorg produces more than 400 products, including pork, Black Angus and Wagyu beef, pink veal, lamb ribs, sausages, poultry, frozen vegetables, dumplings and ready to eat meals.
Miratorg owns supermarket chain under brand Miratorg and restaurant chain Steak & Burger.
In 1990s Alexander and Victor Linnik earned first capital by organizing leisure activities for foreign tourists in Moscow. Then brothers started to import beef and pork from South America.

name: Fredrik Österberg
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2022-2025); Hurun Global (2023-2026)
forbes_bio: Fredrik 'sterberg cofounded Evolution AB with Jens von Bahr in 2006.
Evolution sells casino solutions to online gambling operators, primarily live-streamed tables of blackjack, poker, craps and roulette.
Evolution's first casino studio was set up in Riga, Lithuania in 2006. Today the company has live-casino studios in nine countries, including the U.S.
The company went public in Stockholm in 2015 and today provides its services to over 700 customers in 21 countries. Evolution's products are available globally for end users.
Prior to Evolution, he was CEO of Sportal Nordic.

name: Luo Yangyong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2021-2026); Hurun China (2020-2026)
forbes_bio: Luo Yangyong chairs mining company Sichuan Anning Iron and Titanium.
Luo holds an EMBA from the Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business.
Luo worked as a cashier and construction team leader before he started his own business in the late 1990s.
